props.rationale: Both are residence burglaries in Long Beach, CA, 12 days apart (2024-02-22 and 2024-03-05). Caveats: the ruse comes from a series-wide statement, not from address-specific evidence. Neither case has items, entry point, vehicle or footage recorded. The addresses are different blocks (6800 El Salvador St and 2600 Radnor Ave). The link rests on method, place and timing, and the reports' own series reference. It does not rest on forensic or item overlap.

The neighborhood is not recorded for either case. The two addresses are different blocks (6800 El Salvador St and 2600 Radnor Ave), so a shared neighborhood cannot be claimed.

A matching vehicle (color and body style or make) recorded at both scenes.
A matching distinctive item category taken at both addresses.

A named shared neighborhood for both addresses, or a third case in the same area within a few days.
